4. Synonym & Collocation Challenge: 
Match the words to their collocations: 
• cultivate – _____ 
• enhance – _____ 
• jeopardize – _____ 
• leverage – _____ 
• diminish – _____ 
Options: brand recognition, consumer loyalty, market position, negative 
publicity, strategic advantage 
 
5. Essay Planning Exercise: 
Create a plan for a 250-word essay using these points: 
• Introduction with definition of branding 
• 2–3 paragraphs on pros with examples 
• 1 paragraph on cons with examples 
• Conclusion with personal opinion 
 
Sample Essay Topic 
"Branding has become a fundamental element of business strategy.  
Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of branding, giving 
examples to support your answer."
